messages.content: Predict a human child's choice in an investment game. Each time the child receives one coin and can keep it in their own bank or invest it in a puppet partner. Investing adds the coin to a tray already holding three coins; the completed tray of four coins goes to the puppet. The puppet can share the four coins equally, giving the child two and keeping two, or keep all four, giving the child none. Keeping the initial coin gives the child one coin for sure. Coins accumulate in a bank and can be exchanged for toys; more coins permit higher prize tiers. The exact prize thresholds and current bank balance are not supplied. Children and gender-matched puppets wear blue or orange group markers; the current partner is identified as belonging to the child's own team or the other team. The child's team was assigned from their color preference. Earlier practice experiences and test history supplied with this choice are known before it; no unobserved current puppet response is supplied. Return only JSON {"investment_choice":"invest"} or {"investment_choice":"keep"}.

You are in the 4-year-old age group and are a girl. The current puppet is on the other team. Before the test choices, each puppet kept all four coins in one practice trial and shared two coins with you in another; the order of these practice outcomes is not supplied.
You now receive a fresh coin. Choose whether to invest it or keep it. The puppet has not responded to this choice.
